notes.title: Pest Control 101 w/ the Killbug
notes.content:
[h2][b]G’day, mate. Hope you’re ready for a fight.[/b][/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/ab8530ed9090c35888866749d3850457cd6e244d.png[/img]
Look, I might be the Killbug, but I’m feelin’ charitable today. You’re gonna need some top tips from the master herself if you wanna survive down here.

I’m not gonna just hand it all to ya though. It’s still a bug-eat-bug world, y’know?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4a45e5a7d483bb5397e1651a58de8326fb4e571b.jpg[/img]
[h2]1. Aerial Destruction[/h2]
First up, your gun is gonna do heaps more damage in the air, so don’t waste time hanging out on the ground.

Unfortunately, I lost my wings in a certain exile-related event, (you might’ve heard about it), so double-jumping, knife-jumping and wall-running are my secret weapons. Get some height and rain death from above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/56bbd4355764cd48672711f5dc1edccc8a1456fe.png[/img]
[h2]2. It’s Time to Slam Now[/h2]
There’s one exception to my “get off the ground” rule: you’re allowed to head down there if you’re smashing into it with extreme force. A.K.A, the Ground Slam.

When you’re falling from a decent height, look down and melee when you’re almost at the ground. You’ll smash into the dirt and damage all the creepy crawlies around you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/03030ff0a3def9d2dd655ca77cb55b41f3933112.png[/img]
If you’re feelin’ crazy, you can chain the slams together by jumping, shooting downwards to propel yourself back up, and slamming again. Just rinse and repeat, baby.

I can’t sit around spilling all my trade secrets while there’s still bugs to kill, so this is my final nugget of wisdom.

[h2]3. Centi-peeved[/h2]
I know centipedes are gross, but it’s good to keep them around. They’re like walking health packs! Just make sure you don’t piss them off prematurely; they’ll be all over you like a rash. A disgusting, fast-moving, multi-legged rash.

Alright, I’ve gotta get back to doing what I do best: killin’ some bloody bugs.

Good luck out there, mate.


[i]Cheers,

Your friendly neighbourhood Killbug[/i]

notes.title: Blood for the Deceiver - Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/0680b9028efada7423ee33d794074c468ed2cdba.png[/img]

[h2][b]The Blood for the Deceiver update is here![/b][/h2]

The team has been working hard to bring you as many player-requested features as possible, along with plenty of new secrets to uncover, so we're SUPER excited for everyone to try this update.

Thank you for supporting KILLBUG so far! If you wanna chat with other players, and the Spunk devs, [url=https://discord.gg/samuraipunk]jump into our Discord server![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/ddb6f88a9f769a38bd88e6db38f8b6ba77728c11.png[/img]
[b][h2]Features[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Version increased from 1.0.02 > 1.1.00
[*] Added new late game enemies
[*] Added 29 Steam achievements
[*] Added full controller and mouse and keyboard rebinding, accessible via the 'Control' tab in the options
[*] Added option to use a modifier key for melee dash
[*] Added option to enable a simplified crosshair
[*] Added Arachnophobia Mode with two levels of intensity
[*] Added new weapon abilities
[*] Leaderboard UI overhaul
[*] Mini leaderboard added to main menu
[*] Added button to jump to your position on the global leaderboard
[*] Added buttons to jump to top and bottom of leaderboard
[*] Leaderboard can now be smoothly cycled with mouse, keyboard or controller
[*] Leaderboard now handles more languages
[*] Improved Steam Deck support
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/b159a68ce435906f77159f5eebf1c553de4e3aab.png[/img]
[b][h2]Improvements[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Physics now runs in sync with graphics framerate
[*] Main theme song extended
[*] More lighting variety
[*] New sounds added 
[*] Ambient audio and reverb added to map
[*] Tutorial received some polish 
[*] Made VFX for some enemies more custom to reflect their visual style
[/list]
[b][h2]Balance[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Tapeworms will now retaliate if you stay still for too long while on their backs
[*] Larva Hives now move to avoid the player when they get very close
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4a45e5a7d483bb5397e1651a58de8326fb4e571b.jpg[/img]
[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Demon Shot would be active but the visual would disappear
[*] Fixed issue where healing UI can get stuck on if you take damage immediately after healing
[*] Fixed FOV popping when the game starts up if using non-default settings
[*] Fixed rare bug where melee visual wouldn’t swing but damage would still apply
[*] Fixed bug where centipede head would get deflect flash stuck on after respawn
[/list]

[b][h2]No Leaderboard Wipe?[/h2][/b]
After thorough testing, we decided not to wipe the existing leaderboards, as new scores are higher than before, overall.

notes.title: The Killbug Khronicles - Part Two: The Insectopedia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/ea839b04d89720e80e4b3533b1eb36da7d8ae722.png[/img]

[h2]The Ladybug[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/6eb5cbee5e7cc7345d1556d02a18e02ab68e95e9.png[/img]

Ladybugs are vicious creatures. Impatient and volatile, they hurl themselves at their target when they reach close proximity. It’s best to avoid their violent charges by destroying them from a distance.


[h2]The Bee[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/68b9f335bf34822465cb25a667f6acb3f3c4a00f.png[/img]

Bees are ranged enemies. They fire small honeycomb pieces at their target, dealing significant damage from a distance. While this is their greatest strength, it can also be twisted to your advantage, as a well-timed melee strike will send these projectiles flying straight back at your aerial assailants.


[h2]The Slug[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/ec3a87ab27b4d6dcd10266081be829aac68dcda7.png[/img]

These slimy beasts leave behind trails of oozing pus, painting the battlefield in a poisonous purple sludge. It’s important to avoid their secretions, as the toxicity packs quite a punch.


[h2]The Beetle[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/370571468910eb295faa9d77fa75d5ac73b142e1.png[/img]

Stronger and faster than the ladybugs, beetles are even more dangerous in close-range combat. They charge in a similar manner, but don’t be fooled; they won’t go down easy.


[h2]The Firefly[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/94758efd254798fa54b8e49509049a82e0534060.png[/img]

Fireflies are extremely combustible and will explode in close proximity to their target. These incendiary invaders will also detonate when fired upon or struck with a blade, creating devastating explosions at all distances.


[h2]The Huntsman[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/b840af0d8ab41fbb69aa4910c3d855050b0f3fdd.png[/img]

Huntsman spiders are extremely aggressive. They leap towards their prey, closing distances at terrifying speeds. To avoid their attacks entirely, destroy their eggs before they hatch.


[h2]The Redback[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/cf66313e81c36dd9a69bbb5bddff902685d4197f.png[/img]

Redback spiders utilize the same aggressive attacks as their huntsman counterparts, but their strength is unmatched. With spindly legs and a piercing bite, these arachnid beasts are as agile as they are deadly.


[h2]The Centipede[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4476ededacca992f1e5722279e085d54e851cc7f.png[/img]

Centipedes are resilient fighters. Before you can deliver a fatal blow to the centipede’s head, you must slice or shoot all segments of their body. They move faster with every piece they lose, so the pressure will continue to heighten until they are exterminated.


[h2]The Mosquito[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/efea0d5e8f6c5e4ae9b1c7e237a1cba94ffb4a2a.png[/img]

Mosquitoes travel in bloodthirsty swarms and launch explosive red barbs at their opponent. These projectiles pierce the ground and walls, erupting after a few seconds.

-----------------------------------------------------

[b]Information about some of the insect kingdom’s most vicious beasts is scarce, but don’t fret. It's time to face these monstrosities yourself…[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/38bb11e8a52d4bb2f1d542c8de3a25a5c87caa28.png[/img]

notes.title: The Killbug Khronicles — Part One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/bf4a9cf4184ad8b38c78419f14a070c6b26a19a6.png[/img]

[h3]Deep in the underbelly of our world, skittering at the precipice of human perception, lies a brutal battleground.[/h3]

If you turn your ear to the earth, you can almost hear them.

Droning at the edges of your mind.

Don’t search for too long. Their murmurs may find a way to burrow within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/753b7ecebc1e53685183e56b1933d23a56224fb0.png[/img]

The skittering masses of the insect kingdom are caught in a vicious battle for dominance.

Thousands of eyes. Millions of legs. Endless deaths.

There are no winners in this ancient war.

After the warrior known as [b]the Killbug[/b] crossed the threshold into the human realm, she returned to her insectoid brethren with unprecedented strength and weapons to match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/8c7cbfa1bc0170c0c66b60a9547e12750b0eed8f.png[/img]

Threatened by [b]the Killbug[/b]’s power, all the species of the insect kingdom united to eliminate their greatest opponent.

They clipped her wings and thrust her to the far reaches of the land, but it was not enough to sate their hatred.

[b]The Killbug[/b]’s hunters have mounted a final attack, and every spider, centipede and mutant insectoid monstrosity has joined the ambush.

They hunger for her annihilation.

She thirsts for revenge.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/38bb11e8a52d4bb2f1d542c8de3a25a5c87caa28.png[/img]

[b]KILLBUG[/b] is crawling onto Steam on [b]May 3rd (PDT) / May 4th (AEST)![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/samuraipunk]Join our Discord server to chat about the game with the devs![/url]

Much love,
Samurai Punk <3

notes.title: KILLBUG is crawling onto Steam on May 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/dbd4fa9922753325aefcb9003853841e2bb0f4f0.png[/img]

[h2]Blade and barrel hungry for blood. [/h2]

[h2]Thirsty for the sweet nectar of revenge.[/h2]


[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Community Manager Liv here! I’m keen as a bee-n, (sorry), to be announcing what the Samurai Punk team has been cooking up for you all over the past few months!

After we released JUSTICE SUCKS, Nick started working on a side project prototype for a super cool bug FPS that he dubbed “A Bug’s Death”. After a few months of work, he got us all onboard to bring it to its final form, and [b]KILLBUG[/b] was thrust from the womb of game development! 🐞

[b]Now it’s getting ready to crawl onto Steam on May 3rd (PDT) / May 4th (AEST)![/b]

(See how “crawl” worked as a bug joke and a baby joke? There are layers here, people.)

[previewyoutube=oMi3ry2pQpE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]KILLBUG[/b] is a fast-paced, first-person movement shooter set in an endless arena. Slash and shoot your way through hordes of ravenous insects, mastering fluid aerial movement mechanics as you fight for glory on the leaderboards. 🐝
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/77a0e67fdcd25ff68547323a218140e718118cd5.gif[/img]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battle a wide variety of savage insects.
[*] Destroy hundreds of bugs in fast-paced, brutal combat.
[*] Slash and shoot enemies with your blade and SMG.
[*] Utilize aerial movement mechanics to double-jump, melee-dash, gun-hover and more, quickly adapting to combat different enemy attacks.
[*] Sweat out a new high score on the global leaderboards, or compete to knock your friends off the top spot.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4fd2ad532256bae3044b9950ae323e46d375e600.gif[/img]
We’ll be streaming the game + hosting a Q&A in a Discord stage event on release day, so join our Discord server to be a part of that! ❤️
